explanation:
Assume the global interpolation and analytic aggregate hypotheses.  To prove the eventual lower bound, fix $\nu>2$ and suppose it fails.  Negating the eventual quantifier yields rational approximations of exponent $\nu$ beyond every natural threshold.  The accepted source theorem `OAI.PiExponent.exists_admissible_parameters_source017` constructs fixed admissible data from those approximations.  The source-faithful NoFixedData theorem then applies to that datum and the two global hypotheses, producing a contradiction.  Therefore there is a threshold $Q\ge2$ beyond which

$$
q^{-\nu}\le\left|\pi-\frac pq\right|
$$

for every integer $p$ and natural $q\ge Q$.  The two imported children are the proved A1 existence theorem and the Open NoFixedData target, so this submission is intentionally a dependency sketch.

import Definitions.Def_OAI_PiExponent_ApproximationDefinitions
import Definitions.Def_OAI_NumberTheory_PiExponent_Approximation_DeterminantContradiction_CoreData
import Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_exists_admissible_parameters_source017
import Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_DeterminantContradiction_no_fixed_data_of_interpolation_and_analytic_aggregate

open OAI.PiExponent OAI.PiExponent.DeterminantContradiction

theorem solution
    (hgeometry : GlobalInterpolationStatement) (hanalytic : AnalyticAggregateStatement) :
    PiEventualLowerBound := by
  intro nu hnu
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hbad : ∀ Q : ℕ, ∃ p : ℤ, ∃ q : ℕ,
      Q ≤ q ∧ |Real.pi - (p : ℝ) / q| ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ (-nu) := by
    intro Q
    obtain ⟨p, q, hq, herr⟩ := h (max Q 2) (le_max_right _ _)
    exact ⟨p, q, (le_max_left _ _).trans hq, herr.le⟩
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := OAI.PiExponent.exists_admissible_parameters_source017 nu Arithmetic.lcmConstant collisionConstant
    hnu Arithmetic.lcmConstant_pos collisionConstant_pos hbad
  exact no_fixed_data_of_interpolation_and_analytic_aggregate hgeometry hanalytic nu hnu d
